notes: Ran 4 standard searches on core-facility AXELIOS/SBX rates, installs and early access. I opened no pages. I only saw search snippets, and none gave an AXELIOS core rate. Results were Roche launch coverage (29 Jun 2026): $750K list, $150 per duplex 30x genome in a 16-genome run, RUO, early-access sites Hartwig, Broad, Sanger and Foundation Medicine, CNAG as an early commercial buyer. Core rate-card hits (UCLA, KUMC, Duke, Missouri, Wisconsin) listed only NovaSeq X prices and are already known. No core publishes an AXELIOS rate yet, so there is no same-page AXELIOS vs NovaSeq X comparison. One snippet mentioned an unnamed core 30x WGS rate of about $374 (mid-2026, platform unknown); I could not verify it or name the source.
how_to_mine: Not worth a deep extraction yet. Re-check in 1-2 quarters. Then search specific sites: Broad Clinical Labs and Sanger external service pages, the CNAG tariff page (cnag.eu), and Hartwig.
